featured_reviews.name: Harshad Satelkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
It’s 7 months now after joining, we are extremely satisfied with ACADE Centre. The teachers — Vikas Sir, Dinesh Sir and Kamalesh Sir — all being IIT pass-outs, bring exceptional clarity and depth to every concept.
A special mention to Vikas Sir, who not only motivates the students but also inspires us as parents. His guidance creates a very positive learning environment.
The fortnightly tests help keep students disciplined, consistent and always on track. My daughter’s confidence and understanding have improved tremendously.

featured_reviews.name: Prisha Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
The institute maintains small batch sizes of around 15 students, which ensures that every child receives individual attention. This focused approach helps the teachers closely track each student’s progress and understand where they need support.

I would especially like to mention Vikas Sir for his exceptional teaching and mentorship. His calm and confident approach towards preparing students for such a challenging exam makes a big difference. He encourages students to stay positive and focused, which helps reduce stress and builds their confidence over time.

One of the best aspects of the institute is the detailed review conducted after every test. Each question is discussed thoroughly so that students clearly understand their mistakes and learn the correct methods. This process greatly helps in strengthening concepts and improving performance.

Vikas Sir is also very approachable and always ready to help students with their doubts. His supportive and motivating nature creates a comfortable learning environment where students feel encouraged to ask questions and work harder.

Overall, I truly appreciate the dedication and effort put in by the institute, and I am very happy with the positive impact it has had on me.

featured_reviews.name: Nayana Gadhadra
featured_reviews.review_text: I write this on behalf of my son's experience from last 8 months of Joining Acad.The small batch sizes ensure good interaction between the teachers and the students.The teaching staff and faculty are absolutely amazing giving personal attention to each and every child in the class.The faculty which includes Vikas Sir(Physics), Dinesh Sir(Chemistry), and Kamlesh Sir(Maths) are always present for the students to clear every doubt they have. Overall, the experience of my son has been amazing and he has made great progress in his academics.

featured_reviews.name: Nivedita Malhotra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing this review as my son has been studying at this institute for 8 months.

The small batch size, limited to around 15 students allows for truly personalized attention. The professors are deeply invested in each child’s learning journey and have a clear understanding of every student’s strengths and weaknesses. Their guidance is tailored accordingly, which has made a noticeable difference in my son's performance.

Special mention must be made of Vikas Sir, Dinesh Sir, and Kamlesh Sir. Their approach to such a rigorous exam is optimistic and fearless, creating an environment with significantly less anxiety for the students. Their confidence and positivity rubs off on the children, helping them stay focused and motivated.

After every test, the institute conducts an in-depth analysis of each question, helping students understand their mistakes and improve. Regular parent-teacher meetings ensure that we are always updated about the child’s progress.

The faculty is approachable, supportive, and always willing to clear doubts. Their friendly attitude creates a positive environment that encourages learning.

Overall, we are extremely grateful for the institute’s commitment and the positive learning environment they’ve created.

featured_reviews.name: Kusum Mourya
featured_reviews.review_text:
I write this on the basis of last 8 months of my son's journey with ACAD, I feel I had made a perfect choice by enrolling him at Acad Centric. My cousin brother has given a good review of this class. So we interact with Vikas sir and we were truly impressed by their commitment.

We had a very bad experience at a big institute for my daughter. We want a small batch and also proper attention on my child. A big institute with a large number of students with zero attention to my child made us decide to think of a small batch with experience faculty. We got all this in the Acad centre as all three sir are IITians. Vikas sir, Dinesh sir and Kamlesh sir are excellent and outstanding. They teach on all aspects and also give full attention to every single child.

Strong focus on exam strategies and a supportive atmosphere providing a good learning environment with well-structured lectures, assignments, and  test which improved my son's performance in subjects like math and science.

We are very much satisfied and thankful to them for there good coaching and use effective teaching methods that help with understanding concepts.

featured_reviews.review_text: My daughter has been preparing for NEET here for almost a year and has shown clear improvements. featured_reviews.name: Pravin Mestry
featured_reviews.review_text: After visiting multiple well known institutes in Borivali West , when I met Mr Vikas  n Dinesh Soni for the first time I was totally impressed on the approach of ACAD. I found all three professors very committed , highly experienced and proficient in their respective subjects. Very clear in their aim , way ahead of teaching.The small batch sizes and personalised one-on-one coaching I thought very essential for focused teaching of my son. And I decided not to go for well known classes of 40-50 batch size and joined ACAD for my son.  Now 10 months are passed and I am finding my son is growing on right path. They have tie up with Nirmala collage and that is also going smooth . I highly recommend it to all JEE aspirants for joining ACAD .
